Name: NoLockScreenSlideshow
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent the display of slide shows on the lock screen.

Name: DisableIPSourceRouting
Description: Windows Server 2025 Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) source routing must be configured to the highest protection level to prevent IP source routing.

Name: DisableIPSourceRouting
Description: Windows Server 2025 source routing must be configured to the highest protection level to prevent Internet Protocol (IP) source routing.

Name: EnableICMPRedirect
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to prevent Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) redirects from overriding Open Shortest Path First (OSPF)-generated routes.

Name: AllowInsecureGuestAuth
Description: Windows Server 2025 insecure logons to an SMB server must be disabled.

Name: ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled
Description: Windows Server 2025 command line data must be included in process creation events.

Name: AllowProtectedCreds
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to enable Remote host allows delegation of nonexportable credentials.

Name: DisableWebPnPDownload
Description: Windows Server 2025 downloading print driver packages over HTTP must be turned off.

Name: DisableHTTPPrinting
Description: Windows Server 2025 printing over HTTP must be turned off.

Name: DontDisplayNetworkSelectionUI
Description: Windows Server 2025 network selection user interface (UI) must not be displayed on the logon screen.

Name: DCSettingIndex
Description: Windows Server 2025 users must be prompted to authenticate when the system wakes from sleep (on battery).

Name: ACSettingIndex
Description: Windows Server 2025 users must be prompted to authenticate when the system wakes from sleep (plugged in).

Name: DisableInventory
Description: Windows Server 2025 Application Compatibility Program Inventory must be prevented from collecting data and sending the information to Microsoft.

Name: NoAutoplayfornonVolume
Description: Windows Server 2025 AutoPlay must be turned off for nonvolume devices.

Name: NoAutorun
Description: Windows Server 2025 default AutoRun behavior must be configured to prevent AutoRun commands.

Name: EnumerateAdministrators
Description: Windows Server 2025 administrator accounts must not be enumerated during elevation.

Name: DODownloadMode
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Update must not obtain updates from other PCs on the internet.

Name: NoDataExecutionPrevention
Description: Windows Server 2025 Explorer Data Execution Prevention must be enabled.

Name: NoHeapTerminationOnCorruption
Description: Windows Server 2025 Turning off File Explorer heap termination on corruption must be disabled.

Name: PreXPSP2ShellProtocolBehavior
Description: Windows Server 2025 File Explorer shell protocol must run in protected mode.

Name: DisablePasswordSaving
Description: Windows Server 2025 must not save passwords in the Remote Desktop Client.

Name: fDisableCdm
Description: Windows Server 2025 Remote Desktop Services must prevent drive redirection.

Name: fPromptForPassword
Description: Windows Server 2025 Remote Desktop Services must always prompt a client for passwords upon connection.

Name: fEncryptRPCTraffic
Description: Windows Server 2025 Remote Desktop Services must require secure Remote Procedure Call (RPC) communications.

Name: MinEncryptionLevel
Description: Windows Server 2025 Remote Desktop Services must be configured with the client connection encryption set to High Level.

Name: DisableEnclosureDownload
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent attachments from being downloaded from RSS feeds.

Name: AllowBasicAuthInClear
Description: Windows Server 2025 must disable Basic authentication for RSS feeds over HTTP.

Name: AllowIndexingEncryptedStoresOrItems
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent Indexing of encrypted files.

Name: EnableUserControl
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent users from changing installation options.

Name: AlwaysInstallElevated
Description: Windows Server 2025 must disable the Windows Installer Always install with elevated privileges option.

Name: SafeForScripting
Description: Windows Server 2025 users must be notified if a web-based program attempts to install software.

Name: DisableAutomaticRestartSignOn
Description: Windows Server 2025 must disable automatically signing in the last interactive user after a system-initiated restart.

Name: EnableScriptBlockLogging
Description: Windows Server 2025 PowerShell script block logging must be enabled.

Name: AllowBasic
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not use Basic authentication.

Name: AllowUnencryptedTraffic
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not allow unencrypted traffic.

Name: AllowDigest
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not use Digest authentication.

Name: AllowBasic
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not use Basic authentication.

Name: AllowUnencryptedTraffic
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not allow unencrypted traffic.

Name: DisableRunAs
Description: Windows Server 2025 Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not store RunAs credentials.

Name: LimitBlankPasswordUse
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent local accounts with blank passwords from being used from the network.

Name: SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy
Description: Windows Server 2025 must force audit policy subcategory settings to override audit policy category settings.

Name: RequireSignOrSeal
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Domain member: Digitally encrypt or sign secure channel data (always) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: SealSecureChannel
Description: Windows Server 2025 setting Domain member: Digitally encrypt secure channel data (when possible) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: SignSecureChannel
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Domain member: Digitally sign secure channel data (when possible) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: DisablePasswordChange
Description: Windows Server 2025 computer account password must not be prevented from being reset.

Name: RequireStrongKey
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to require a strong session key.

Name: RequireSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Microsoft network client: Digitally sign communications (always) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: EnableSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Microsoft network client: Digitally sign communications (if server agrees) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: RequireSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: EnableSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows Server 2025 setting Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (if client agrees) must be configured to Enabled.

Name: RestrictAnonymousSAM
Description: Windows Server 2025 must not allow anonymous enumeration of Security Account Manager (SAM) accounts.

Name: RestrictAnonymous
Description: Windows Server 2025 must not allow anonymous enumeration of shares.

Name: EveryoneIncludesAnonymous
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to prevent anonymous users from having the same permissions as the Everyone group.

Name: RestrictNullSessAccess
Description: Windows Server 2025 must restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares.

Name: UseMachineId
Description: Windows Server 2025 services using Local System that use Negotiate when reverting to NTLM authentication must use the computer identity instead of authenticating anonymously.

Name: allownullsessionfallback
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent NTLM from falling back to a Null session.

Name: AllowOnlineID
Description: Windows Server 2025 must prevent PKU2U authentication using online identities.

Name: SupportedEncryptionTypes
Description: Windows Server 2025 Kerberos encryption types must be configured to prevent the use of DES and RC4 encryption suites.

Name: LmCompatibilityLevel
Description: Windows Server 2025 LAN Manager authentication level must be configured to send NTLMv2 response only and to refuse LM and NTLM.

Name: LDAPClientIntegrity
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to at least negotiate signing for LDAP client signing.

Name: NTLMMinClientSec
Description: Windows Server 2025 session security for NTLM SSP-based clients must be configured to require NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption.

Name: NTLMMinServerSec
Description: Windows Server 2025 session security for NTLM SSP-based servers must be configured to require NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption.

Name: ForceKeyProtection
Description: Windows Server 2025 users must be required to enter a password to access private keys stored on the computer.

Name: Enabled
Description: Windows Server 2025 must be configured to use FIPS-compliant algorithms for encryption, hashing, and signing.

Name: ProtectionMode
Description: Windows Server 2025 default permissions of global system objects must be strengthened.
